page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; two portrait medallions (woodcuts) in the upper part; one column of running text below them; signature at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: CHRISTIERNVS Ioannis Daniæ Regis filius, post
patris obitum Danorum Rex, nullum non lapidem mouit quo
regnum Suecię suo regno adiiceret: quod & tandem partim vi
armorum, partim dolo assecutus est: sed tamē non diu admini-
strauit: quinimo tantum abest vt retinere potuerit, vt etiam pa-
trio ac peculiari suo regno Daniæ ob tyrānidem deturbaretur,
atque exul in Angliam vnà cū vxore profugeret, anno à mundo
condito 5484. à Christo nato 1522. Cæterum cùm Daniam re-
cuperare tentaret, à Christiano, patruo suo, captus est, atque in
carcerem cõiectus, vbi diem clausit extremum. Vide Cosmog.
Mun. li.4. de regnis Septentrionalibus: item nouam temporum
continuationem Germani cuiusdam, ad Euse.Chro. adiectam:
præterea Carionis Chro. li.3. qui loco Daniæ scribit Regē Chri-
stiernum Daciæ: vnde colligendum Daniam, & Daciam, inte-
rim confundi, nam & Volater. li. 7. sic inquit: Nunc sanè Cim-
bricam Chersonesum Daciam vocant, cui Rex præest qui Sue-
tiam & Noruegiam, peninsulas, in eodem mari obtinet, Ptole-
mæo & antiquis minimè positas, quòd ignotæ atque incom-
pertæ tunc essent.
ISABELLA Caroli Imperatoris huius nominis quinti so-
ror, nupsit Christierno Danię Regi supradicto, qui ex ea liberos
sustulit, Dorotheam Friderici Palatini vxorem, & Christianam,
Lotharingiæ Ducissam. Vide vt suprà.

page.notes: The two medallions at the top are woodcut portraits with legends printed in them: left "CHRIS III REX DA." (Christiernus III, King of Denmark) and right "ELIZABET R. DA." (Elizabeth, Queen of Denmark). Not transcribed as running text; they are illustrations. The page number "233" is printed at the top right, set in an old-style figure. In the signature the final figure is printed in an unusual form, read here as 5.
